title: Acceptance probability
statement: For a configuration $C$ of a finite nondeterministic Turing machine on a fixed input and a natural number $j$, define its acceptance probability after using $j$ random bits as the probability that running the machine from $C$ with those random bits yields an accepting configuration.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration $C$ on its fixed input
